Effekseer for WebGL v1.70: MIT License, © Effekseer contributors. Source: https://github.com/effekseer/EffekseerForWebGL
Effect files and referenced resources are from the same repository's tests/Resources directory.
The WebGL JavaScript runtime and WebAssembly binary match pinned upstream revision e8c3ce076644789918695b0cba0031461c817890. The verified WebAssembly binary is downloaded during development/build and served from /vendor/effekseer/effekseer.wasm, not from a third-party host at runtime.

Additional authored VFX (pinned by Git blob checksum and downloaded at build time):
- EffekseerForGodot4 official Godot sample effects, revision 8706d2917c2487efac3a4943c16a10dfcfc5b127, https://github.com/effekseer/EffekseerForGodot4 (MIT License, Copyright © 2020 Effekseer; retain license notice).
- tktk contributed effect files (CC0, Effekseer sample collection), mirrored in newold3/Godot-RPG-Creator revision e7d2d69193022f1d000c0bf96eee0b5561e2183f, https://github.com/newold3/Godot-RPG-Creator ; associated tktk textures from EffekseerForWebGL revision e8c3ce076644789918695b0cba0031461c817890.
- Official upstream sample catalogue: https://effekseer.github.io/en/contribute.html ; tktk collection appears under contributor sample effects.
Every referenced texture/model/material is served locally as part of the game VFX module. These are licensed, pre-authored effects; the Rune manifestation code does not synthesize particles.


Rune manifestation v2: 66 unique effect files + 66 unique semantic object pictograms. The letterforms remain the protagonist. Additional Effect filenames do not mean visual effectiveness is confirmed: browser and device review are separate.
- EffekseerForGodot4 sample-material1 MIT-licensed authored optical and dissolve effects (same pinned official upstream revision as above).
- game-icons/icons, upstream revision 82d948812bfe3f269ef8f731dcdb07b08160edc4, by Lorc, Delapouite and additional named icon contributors; CC BY 3.0 (selected badges may be public domain). Original per-icon author directories are preserved in app/lrunes/effekseer/rune-semantic-icons.mjs and may be credited at https://game-icons.net/ . License terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ .
- Every icon and every effect dependency is pinned to a SHA-1 Git blob and made available from the same origin at build time. 66 separate VFX files are selected for the drawable runes, not 66 names aliasing fewer assets.

Rune manifestation authored-module resourcing (2026-10-12):
- 34 rejected VFX bindings are now sourced from the existing CC0 MAGICAL X SPIRAL Effekseer contributed-effects collection. The project uses unchanged .efkefc files and the existing Effekseer WebGL runtime, not generated particle effects.
- Pinned source mirror: https://github.com/munokura/Effekseer-sample-for-RPG-Tkool-MZ at 7faccfd4c769d49f56877950eb4b815846b952e5; MAGICALxSPIRAL/MxS_*.efkefc, with Texture/ and Model/ referenced resources.
- Upstream Effekseer CC0 catalogue: https://effekseer.github.io/en/contribute.html . Material names alone are not proof of semantic correctness: artist visual approval remains required.

Rune manifestation full replacement (2026-10-25): 37 additional CC0 MAGICAL X SPIRAL authored effect scenes pinned to their exact original revision, SHA-1 and size. All 59 source-model/texture dependencies were already pinned. 22 effects changed in the prior pass and the remaining 44 original assignments are now also changed; there are 66 different main VFX binaries, with no bare shader/tutorial particle scene selected as a main effect. Rendering parity and density remain pending screenshot/device QA; compiled assets and build success do not establish artistic equivalence.
